labels.name: upstream
labels.rationale: Vulnerability advisory concerning the Pygments dependency, not Rich's own code.

items.body:
This concerns a vulnerability advisory for the Pygments dependency, not code in Rich itself, so it has been labelled `upstream`. Rich declares its Pygments requirement in [pyproject.toml](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/pyproject.toml). For private vulnerability reports, please follow [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/SECURITY.md) rather than a public issue. A maintainer will review this.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
